changeSet.author: gboyeguntaiwo
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_enrollment SET gaweeks = FLOOR((pmtct_enrollment_date - lmp) / 7.0), last_modified_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_by = 'SYSTEM_GA_FIX' WHERE archived = false AND lmp IS NOT NULL AND pmtct_enrollment_date IS NOT NULL AND gaweeks IS NOT NULL AND gaweeks > 0 -- Only update records where calculated GA is valid (4-45 weeks) AND FLOOR((pmtct_enrollment_date - lmp) / 7.0) BETWEEN 4 AND 45 -- Only update if stored GA differs from calculated GA AND FLOOR((pmtct_enrollment_date - lmp) / 7.0) != gaweeks;

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_enrollment SET gaweeks = FLOOR((pmtct_enrollment_date - lmp) / 7.0), last_modified_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_by = 'SYSTEM_GA_FIX' WHERE archived = false AND lmp IS NOT NULL AND pmtct_enrollment_date IS NOT NULL AND (gaweeks IS NULL OR gaweeks = 0) -- Only update if calculated GA is valid (4-45 weeks) AND FLOOR((pmtct_enrollment_date - lmp) / 7.0) BETWEEN 4 AND 45;

changeSet.author: gboyeguntaiwo
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_mother_visitation pmv SET ga_weeks = d.gaweeks, last_modified_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_by = 'SYSTEM_GA_FIX_DELIVERY' FROM pmtct_delivery d WHERE pmv.patient_uuid = d.patient_uuid AND pmv.pmtct_cycle_uuid = d.pmtct_cycle_uuid AND pmv.archived = false AND d.archived = false AND pmv.date_of_visit >= d.date_of_delivery AND d.gaweeks IS NOT NULL AND pmv.ga_weeks != d.gaweeks;

changeSet.author: gboyeguntaiwo
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_mother_visitation pmv SET ga_weeks = CASE WHEN FLOOR((d.date_of_delivery - pe.lmp) / 7.0) > 45 THEN 45 ELSE FLOOR((d.date_of_delivery - pe.lmp) / 7.0) END, last_modified_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_by = 'SYSTEM_GA_CALC_AT_DELIVERY' FROM pmtct_delivery d JOIN pmtct_enrollment pe ON d.patient_uuid = pe.patient_uuid AND d.pmtct_cycle_uuid = pe.pmtct_cycle_uuid AND pe.archived = false WHERE pmv.patient_uuid = d.patient_uuid AND pmv.pmtct_cycle_uuid = d.pmtct_cycle_uuid AND pmv.archived = false AND d.archived = false AND pmv.date_of_visit >= d.date_of_delivery AND d.gaweeks IS NULL AND pe.lmp IS NOT NULL AND FLOOR((d.date_of_delivery - pe.lmp) / 7.0) >= 0;

changeSet.author: gboyeguntaiwo
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_mother_visitation pmv SET ga_weeks = 45, last_modified_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_by = 'SYSTEM_GA_CAP_45' FROM pmtct_enrollment pe LEFT JOIN pmtct_delivery d ON d.patient_uuid = pe.patient_uuid AND d.pmtct_cycle_uuid = pe.pmtct_cycle_uuid AND d.archived = false WHERE pmv.patient_uuid = pe.patient_uuid AND pmv.pmtct_cycle_uuid = pe.pmtct_cycle_uuid AND pmv.archived = false AND pe.archived = false AND pmv.ga_weeks > 45 AND (d.date_of_delivery IS NULL OR pmv.date_of_visit < d.date_of_delivery);
